title: Session Cleaner
description: A SessionManager stores sessions in memory but never cleans them up, so it leaks. Add a cleaner goroutine that removes sessions idle for more than 5s, without race conditions.
task: Implement a session cleaner that runs concurrently in the background and cleans every session not updated for more than 5 seconds. Be careful about race conditions.
hints: Track the last update time of each session.
A background goroutine should poll (e.g. every second) and delete stale sessions.
Guard the sessions map with a mutex; renew the session expiry on update.
starterFails: starter.go never cleans sessions, so sessions leak after 7s (test fails)
referenceFixes: reference.go adds a cleaner goroutine + mutex and removes stale sessions
